description: Re-send a captured event to any URL — the test runner for a handler you just wrote. preserve_headers defaults to true so the original signature header (e.g. Stripe-Signature) arrives intact. If you changed the body or the receiver verifies with a different secret, pass resign_with (the dev's own signing secret) so the payload is re-signed and their verification code passes unmodified. Returns the response status, latency and body.

body.description: Replacement request body (defaults to the captured body).

headers.description: Header overrides layered on top of the preserved set.

preserve_headers.description: Replay the captured headers verbatim (default true).

resign_with.description: Signing secret to re-sign the payload with (≥16 chars).

url.description: Destination URL to send it to.

name: replay_event
